name: Exhausted
description: Worn down by exertion or a missed rest. Body and reflexes suffer until a full night's sleep. Takes up an inventory slot.

name: Frightened
description: Shaken by something dreadful. Nerve fails until the mouse feels safe again. Takes up an inventory slot.

name: Hungry
description: A missed meal. Everything is a little harder until the mouse eats. Takes up an inventory slot.

name: Injured
description: A lingering wound that slows the body. Cleared by a week of care. Takes up an inventory slot.

name: Drained
description: Hollowed out by magic or dread. The will is dulled until a long rest. Takes up an inventory slot.
